reflection: Round 1 shows nothing passed: most factors had mixed-sign gains with 2024 consistently negative (worst -0.025 to -0.039), suggesting 2024's calm trending regime punishes features tuned to reversals or intraday location. Features similar to existing ones (zscore of returns, close zscore) add nothing. Peer returns (MSFT_return_1d) are the most useful existing inputs, and Apple's volatility level matters, so I will try features about peer dispersion and volatility regime relative to QQQ, plus smoother, less noisy versions of the 2022/2023 winners. Note the aapl_vol_ratio_5_20 formula actually used a 60 window, so I'll try a real 5/20 ratio with market normalization.

lessons.name: aapl_vol_ratio_5_20
lessons.lesson: Short/long vol ratio mostly duplicates AAPL_volatility_5d and carries no directional information, so it failed in nearly every year.

lessons.name: msft_return_zscore_20
lessons.lesson: Standardizing MSFT's return is nearly a copy of MSFT_return_1d and only helped RF in calm years, with 2024 hurt by noise.

lessons.name: aapl_close_zscore_60
lessons.lesson: A 60-day price z-score is redundant with 20d return and trend features and gave negative gain in every year.

lessons.name: qqq_vol_ratio_5_60
lessons.lesson: QQQ vol-spike ratio only helped in turbulent 2025; in other regimes it was noise for next-day direction.

lessons.name: aapl_overnight_gap
lessons.lesson: Relative overnight gap helped LR in 2023 but was a large negative in 2024, likely because gaps mean-revert inconsistently across regimes.

lessons.name: aapl_close_location_minus_qqq
lessons.lesson: Relative close location is a noisy one-day intraday quantity that flipped sign between 2022-23 and 2024-25.

factors.name: aapl_gap_rolling_mean_5
factors.hypothesis: The single-day relative gap was too noisy and flipped in 2024; averaging over 5 days keeps persistent overnight relative strength and cuts noise.

factors.name: aapl_close_loc_5d_mean
factors.hypothesis: Dropping the QQQ term and smoothing over 5 days gives Apple's buying-pressure trend, avoiding the one-day noise that broke 2024 and 2025.

factors.name: peer_dispersion_1d
factors.hypothesis: When MSFT and NVDA disagree strongly, tech leadership is rotating, which may change how Apple follows the peers the next day.

factors.name: aapl_vs_qqq_vol_20
factors.hypothesis: Apple's idiosyncratic risk relative to the sector indicates stock-specific stress regimes (e.g. 2025) in which direction behaves differently.

factors.name: msft_nvda_5d_spread_to_aapl
factors.hypothesis: MSFT's one-day return is useful; Apple's 5-day lag versus peers adds a catch-up component that complements it as a slower relative move.

factors.name: qqq_volume_surge_peer
factors.hypothesis: Apple's volatility level is informative; QQQ volume surge identifies whether the volatility is market-wide participation, giving a conditional interaction.
